notes.scope: Relevant public prediction fields of Results, not a JSON serialization or a complete inventory of object attributes. Batched prediction returns a list; stream=True returns a generator.
notes.box_columns: x1, y1, x2, y2, confidence, class; tracking inserts track_id between y2 and confidence. IDs are numeric entries in the tensor, not separate integer arrays.
notes.coordinates: boxes.data uses original-image pixel corners; orig_shape is (height, width). Class index meanings come from names.
notes.empty: boxes.data has zero rows for no detections.
notes.producer: YOLO.predict(...): one Results object per image
notes.representation: Arrays describe tensor/ndarray dimensions, and objects describe public attributes. Actual values remain Python objects, tensors and arrays, not JSON. names is a dictionary mapping integer class indices to strings.
notes.numeric_storage: Box tensors store floating-point entries, including class and tracking IDs. Those ID columns are declared integer because that is their expected safe cast target. Storage precision depends on the producer/runtime; consumers must preserve ID values during conversion.
